@contents: The button that lists the book's table of contents, and that list's title.
@mode: The button in the comic and PDF readers that switches between the three modes below.
@mode_continuous: The pages run top to bottom in one scrolling column.
@mode_ltr: Page by page, the next page to the right.
mode_not_saved: The reading mode couldn't be saved.
@mode_not_saved: The book stays in the new mode while it is open; the server keeps the old one.
@mode_rtl: Page by page, the next page to the left, as manga are read.
@open_failed: The book's file arrived, but the app can't read it — for example, because it is damaged.
@page_of: Shown while reading a comic; {page} is the page on screen, {count} how many pages the book has.
@percent: A zoom step or the text size; {percent} is a number such as 150.
unsupported: The app can't show this kind of book yet.
@unsupported: Shown for a book in a format the app has no reader for.
@zoom: The dropdown of zoom steps in the PDF, comic and fixed-layout EPUB readers.
@zoom_fit_page: The whole page fits the window.
@zoom_fit_width: The page is as wide as the window.
